title: Audio Channel Assignments for Digital Television Tape Recorders with AES/EBU Digital Audio Input
scope: 1.1 This guideline specifies the allocation of input audio signals to digital audio channels on digital television tape recorders (DTTRs) when the inputs are connected through AES/EBU digital interfaces. 1.2 This guideline also specifies preferred assignments of programs to audio recording channels, on the basis of program type, for purposes of program exchange.
